Assertoric responsibility and rational agency give reasons against contrary assertion, but actual-assent and exceptionless-priority steps remain disputed. Strongest welfare/agency rival owes a complete good comparison and an override justification; no existing evidence establishes universal truthful-alternative dominance or defeats it. Full actual intellectual perfection remains a stronger positive account, not refuted by finite fallible subjects or structural reference proxies. Root A needs only accuracy at identical actual asserted-and-assented contents, but choosing that scope does not warrant its cognitive success. No duplicate predicates/proofs/models; operation-identity and due-cognitive-privation applicability to same GOD_4 plus actual contingent reference remain exact gaps. Next material dependency is actual operation/perfection rather than power, or an independently warranted inerrant domain with assertion coverage. No premise change. Blanket active/passive equivocation objection misses the source own distinction. Esse/essence Principle equality does not identify a separate O operation. Extrinsic mismatch architecture and strongest causal/exemplar reply remain live with intentional adequacy obligations; frozen unindexed assent does not preserve source time/content treatment. No new map/flag/proof; next test calibrates immanent cognitive form/operation and passive subject-act potentiality, then one actual asserted contingent content with separate selection/reference/efficacy. No premise change. Recipient-directed historical-inquiry continuation, 2026-11-24, at docs/notes/divine-veracity-1410.md#recipient-directed-nondeception-and-historical-inquiry-2026-11-24. Distinguishes an actual end of true historical understanding from mere useful prediction. Such an end supplies a defeasible reason against systematic false-history policy when knowledge, a genuinely superior feasible truthful policy or a defended recipient-protection prohibition, effective choice and actual channel scope are supported. Reuses the existing tied-optimum boundary: equal benefit does not exclude false inducement without strict full-order dominance or an additional norm. Restores ordinary local error/correction, fiction, secondary agency and independently identified proper conditions; a fallible inquiry end is not a promise that every record is true. SourceEvidenceAdequacy supplies a conditional individuated-content assembly plus populated production/transport omissions and a matching nonmental copying control, all without deriving source veracity itself. Comparative advantage over a comparably warranted necessary impersonal mechanism remains underdetermined; direct, primitive and cumulative warrant are retained. No source attribution or computed root premise change.

current_assessment.scope: Application of individuated source veracity to observed historical records and recipient-directed epistemic ends
current_assessment.assessment: The source-to-record assembly is conditionally valid with intentional/assertoric coverage, effective production, same-source provenance and truth-preserving transport. It does not infer those application premises from goodness or necessary existence. The strongest recipient-directed reply supplies a substantive reason against knowingly fabricated history if the source actually adopts true historical understanding as an end and a feasible truthful policy is strictly better in the complete relevant ordering, or a separately defended recipient-protection constraint excludes false inducement. Equal-valued optima alone do not discriminate. Ordinary fallible, corrigible inquiry may satisfy a weaker epistemic undertaking without making every record true; fiction, interference and free secondary agents require explicit scope and defeater analysis. Direct, primitive and cumulative warrant remains eligible for both a theistic undertaking and an impersonal truth-tracking nature. The current evidence supports no unconditional record guarantee and no comparative worldview winner.
